description: Whole-brain deterministic tractography with DIPY: single-shell constrained spherical deconvolution (CSD) on the b0s and one diffusion shell (the highest by default), seeded where FA is above seed_fa and stopped where FA falls below stop_fa. Writes the tractogram as .trk in the DWI's world space, the FA map it used, and an inline summary.

dwi.description: Preprocessed 4-D diffusion series (e.g. fsl-eddy's dwi), one volume per gradient-table entry.

gradients.description: FSL .bval or .bvec (the sibling with the same stem is read too), e.g. fsl-eddy's gradients with its rotated .bvec.

mask.description: Brain mask on the dwi grid, e.g. fsl-topup's brain_mask; defaults to voxels with a non-zero mean b0.

shell.description: b-value of the shell for CSD; the highest shell when unset.

sh_order.description: Maximum spherical-harmonic order of the CSD fit (even).

seed_fa.description: Seed in voxels with FA above this.

stop_fa.description: Stop a streamline where FA falls below this.

seeds_per_voxel.description: Seed density per dimension in each seed voxel (n gives n^3 seeds).

min_length.description: Drop streamlines shorter than this, in mm.

b0_threshold.description: b-values at or below this count as b0.

tractogram.description: Whole-brain streamlines, TrackVis .trk, RAS mm in the DWI's world space.

fa.description: FA from a tensor fit on b0 + the shell nearest b=1000, used for seeding and stopping.

summary.description: streamlines, seeds, length_mm {mean, median, max}, csd_shell, sh_order, response_ratio and the tracking parameters.

requirements: Python 3.10+ with dipy 1.9+, nibabel and numpy; set NEUROFLOW_PYTHON to the environment
neuroflow/launch.description: python_tool.mjs checks the Python environment, then calls nf_dipy_tracking.run(...): tensor FA, auto_response_ssst, CSD peaks (multi-process), LocalTracking; tractogram.trk and fa.nii.gz land in the output dir and the summary in $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_FILE.

requirements.advice: pip install dipy into that environment, or point NEUROFLOW_PYTHON at one that has it

useWhen: Make a whole-brain tractogram from a preprocessed diffusion series to view or to feed tract and connectivity tools.
Show the major white-matter tracts of one subject in NiiVue.

avoidWhen.when: The diffusion series has not been corrected for distortion and eddy currents.
You need only scalar maps such as FA and MD.

preconditions: dwi has b0 volumes and at least one shell with enough directions for the CSD order (45 for order 8).
effects: Writes tractogram.trk and fa.nii.gz to the output directory.

duration.basis: Estimate, not measured in the gallery: minutes for a 2 mm whole-brain series, dominated by the CSD fit and tracking.

examples.title: From fsl-eddy outputs with the topup mask

failures.meaning: Nothing passed the FA and length thresholds.
failures.remedy: Check the mask and gradients; lower seed_fa or min_length.

failures.meaning: The requested shell is not in the data.
failures.remedy: Leave shell unset or pick one the error lists.
